1.label: very_easy
1.summary: 11×9 maze with 2 wanted travellers and matched protected look-alikes. Independent continuous corridor walks; the first miss or protected hit ends the attempt.
1.natural_language: Navigate the maze and identify every moving wanted traveller from the portraits. Aim and fire while protecting their look-alikes. A missed shot or protected hit ends the attempt.

simplified.summary: Use the labelled movement, turn, and fire buttons below the viewport to produce the same discrete first-person actions.

full.summary: Use W/A/S/D and arrow keys to move and turn, drag the viewport to look, and click the viewport or press Space to fire.
